description: Local reproducibility package accompanying the ECLS structural sequence-scoring manuscript. The frozen primary result compares deposited native CDR-H3 sequences with composition-matched shuffles on a one-time temporal panel of 31 structures and 15 antigen clusters (mean ECLS advantage 0.172281; cluster-bootstrap 95% CI 0.059156 to 0.291920). Includes the ECLS manuscript source, protocol, frozen final result, reviewer archive, source manifest, and legacy supporting research artifacts. Contact-v2 material is development provenance only. The PAE surrogate is a separate manuscript revision and is excluded from this deposit. No general candidate-reranking, successful antibody design, binding, affinity or efficacy claim is made. Package preparation does not establish journal submission, acceptance, or remote publication.
